run_asr_inference: run speech recognition inference on pre-processed data with a trained fairseq model
run_infer_cli: run the infer CLI to decode speech audio using a fairseq ASR model checkpoint
run_dump_emissions: run inference to dump model emissions to a numpy file for offline decoding
run_dump_features: run inference to dump encoder features from the model for external processing
run_w2l_decoder: run speech recognition using a viterbi, kenlm, or fairseqlm w2l decoder
